STANZA I
Now have our hearts embraced our God
Now have our hearts embraced our God,
We would forget all earthly charms,
And wish to die, as Simeon would,
With his young Savior in his arms.
No line of this stanza quotes a verse closely; it is the hymn's own confession.
Where Watts found it
Watts printed the hymn under Luke 2:28. The line that comes closest to it is marked.
Simeon took Him in his arms and blessed God, saying: LUKE 2:28 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ LUKE 2
